[SWS_UCM_00285] Removing or updating a Software Cluster not existing in the Machine
⌈
If a Software Package’s action is to remove or update
a Software Cluster that is not existing in the Machine, UCM shall raise Appli-
cationError SoftwareClusterMissing when ProcessSwPackage is called.
⌋

[SWS_UCM_00285] Removing or updating a Software Cluster not ex- isting in the Machine
⌈
If a Software Package’s action is to remove or update a Software Cluster that is not at one of the states kPresent, kRemoved, kUpdat-
ing and kAdded, UCM shall raise ApplicationError SoftwareClusterMissing
when ProcessSwPackage is called.
⌋

[SWS_UCM_00285] Removing or updating a Software Cluster not ex- isting in the Machine
⌈
If a Software Package’s action is to remove or update a
Software Cluster that is not at one of the states kPresent, kRemoved, kUpdat-
ing and kAdded, UCM shall raise ApplicationError kSoftwareClusterMiss-
ing when ProcessSwPackage is called.
⌋

[SWS_UCM_00285] Removing or updating a Software Cluster not existing in the Machine
⌈
If a Software Package’s action is to remove or update a Software Cluster that
is not at one of the states kPresent, kRemoved, kUpdating and kAdded, UCM shall
raise ApplicationError kSoftwareClusterMissing when ProcessSwPack-
age is called. The Processing State of a Software Package (processingState)
shall transition to kProcessingFailed.
⌋

[SWS_UCM_00285] Removing or updating a Software Cluster not existing in the Machine
⌈
If a Software Package’s action is to remove or update a Software Cluster that
is not at one of the states kPresent, kRemoved, kUpdating and kAdded, UCM shall
raise ApplicationError kSoftwareClusterMissing when ProcessSwPack-
age is called. The Processing State of a Software Package (processingState)
shall transition to kProcessingFailed.
⌋
